info.title: SDKWork Account Backend API
info.description: Backend wallet write commands and operational health for integrators.

post.description: Claims a batch of pending acct_outbox_event rows, marks them PUBLISHED, and returns payloads for downstream relay workers.
Creates a cash ledger adjustment. `assetType` is forced to `cash`.
Creates a points ledger adjustment and applies FIFO lot movement.
Sweeps expired points lots, debits account balances, and writes ledger plus allocation rows.
Checks points accounts for lot remaining vs available mismatches.
Creates a hold moving balance from available to frozen.
Sweeps expired holds and restores frozen balance to available.
Atomically transfers available balance between two accounts of the same asset type.
Credits Token Bank balance after governed purchase, issuance, or service income.
Debits Token Bank balance for direct AI consumption or burn.
Credits Token Bank balance for platform, subscription, compensation, or campaign grants.
Appends a Token Bank reversal ledger entry for a previous movement.
Creates a Token Bank hold moving balance from available to frozen.
Settles a Token Bank hold after final metered usage.
Releases unused or failed-task Token Bank hold balance.
Transfers Token Bank balance between accounts of the same asset type.

businessType.description: Lowercase snake_case ledger business type (validated by CommerceLedgerBusinessType).

expiresAt.description: Optional points lot expiry for credit adjustments.

reversedLedgerId.description: Optional original ledger entry id when posting a compensating adjustment.

ownerUserId.description: Optional scope filter; when set only lots owned by this user are swept.

accountId.description: Optional scope filter; when set only lots for this account are swept.
